scripts.all:setup: bun run all:deps && (bun run db:restore || true) && bun run db:down && echo 'Setup complete. You can now run `bun run presta:up` to start the PrestaShop environment.'
scripts.all:deps: bun run presta:deps && (cd scrapper && bun run deps) && (cd selenium && bun run deps)
scripts.presta:deps: cd prestashop && docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml pull && docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml build
scripts.presta:up: cd prestashop && docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml up -d
scripts.presta:down: cd prestashop && docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml down
scripts.presta:del: bun run presta:down && sudo rm -rf prestashop/src && docker volume rm prestashop_mariadb-data prestashop_caddy_data prestashop_caddy_config
scripts.presta:restart: bun run presta:down && bun run presta:up
scripts.db:up: cd prestashop && docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml up -d db
